This proposal requests 11,787,063 ada for a program that duplicates active ecosystem work, neither naming nor building upon it. What the ecosystem needs from OpenZeppelin is security credibility, standardization practice, and distribution. 6eddf4f1dbad06f329aa69743559c4930b7b689f.name: YUTA
6eddf4f1dbad06f329aa69743559c4930b7b689f.excerpt: I vote NO on “Cardano Strategic Copper Reserve”. As I understand it, this proposal asks for ₳22M to get three things. I looked at each one in numbers to see whether the cost is justified. Treasury diversification (buying copper): I don’t think the cost is justified, and there is a risk of losing principal. Of the ₳22M, ₳14.7M (about 67%) goes into buying copper. The remaining ~₳7.3M (about 33%) is spent as fees regardless of the copper price. By the proposal’s own numbers, copper must rise about 49% (about $10.06/lb) just to return the principal, and the sale is planned for 2028–2029. The ₳22M also goes first into an account controlled by the recipient (Toto Finance). Independent oversight…

6eddf4f1dbad06f329aa69743559c4930b7b689f.name: Dori
6eddf4f1dbad06f329aa69743559c4930b7b689f.excerpt: I'm voting No on the Cardano Strategic Copper Reserve proposal. First, despite being framed as Cardano RWA, the canonical token is issued on Ethereum. The copper tokens are minted as ERC-20s on Ethereum and locked in escrow, and only a bridged representation circulates on Cardano. There is no reason this couldn't be issued natively on Cardano, yet Treasury funds would pay for Ethereum issuance and bridge infrastructure, with the Treasury also bearing the bridge risk the proposer itself acknowledges. And this is effectively the Treasury taking a bet on commodity prices. The proposal itself states that, if the full fee ceilings are used, copper would need to rise roughly 50% just to recover…

The money is held by independent people, it’s paid out only as each stage is delivered, and it’s checked by outside auditors along the way. I support it, and I’ll be watching to see whether real lenders start using it.

Its open, shared infrastructure could provide long-term value by enabling multiple lending protocols and financial institutions to connect and operate more efficiently. minSize.reason: no parameter snapshot at or before the window

totalDrepPowerAda.definition: Summed voting power (lovelace) over every non-special DRep snapshot row for the epoch.

poweredDrepCount.definition: Non-special DRep snapshot rows with voting power above zero this epoch.

recentlyVotingDrepCount.definition: DReps that voted at least once in the last 12 epochs, superseded votes included. Votes without a block time are not counted.

silentPoweredDrepCount.definition: DReps holding delegated power in the epoch snapshot with no vote in the last 12 epochs, superseded votes included. NULL until the repair pass has read the epoch.

abstainPowerAda.definition: Voting power (lovelace) delegated to the predefined always-abstain option this epoch.

ancPowerAda.definition: Voting power (lovelace) delegated to the predefined no-confidence option this epoch.

delegatorTotal.definition: Sum of live-observed delegator counts over the epoch snapshot rows, set only when every row carries an observation, never a partial sum.

abstainDelegators.definition: Live-observed delegator count of the always-abstain option, recorded from the epoch stamping began.

ancDelegators.definition: Live-observed delegator count of the no-confidence option, recorded from the epoch stamping began.

gini.definition: Gini coefficient of voting power across snapshot rows with power above zero, excluding the predefined options.

top10SharePct.definition: Share of the epoch total held by the ten largest non-special DReps, computed from the raw power distribution.

minCoalition50.definition: Fewest DReps whose combined voting power reaches 50% of the epoch total, based on delegated power, not actual coordination.

minCoalition67.definition: Fewest DReps whose combined voting power reaches 67% of the epoch total, based on delegated power, not actual coordination.

votesCast.definition: DRep votes cast during the epoch, later-superseded votes included. Votes without a block time are not counted.
